version: F11_PROPOSED opening dialogue (SC01–07) — DRAFT, full prose from the beat inventory
status: DRAFT — NOT accepted. F10 frozen & unchanged. Globally-intelligible English; Björn-led; canon-continuous.
canonContinuity: Himinkljúfr (greatsword) on Björn's back; Olaf grey/failing (kinsman, hands leadership to Björn); two suns; steering-oar (NOT a wheel); the 'wrong tide'/bleed; Seth-Nakht = fear-authority; Astrid reads the water; IPU a re-gendered boy with a water-jug.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: She's taking us beam-on — if you hold her, she rolls!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Then I hold.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: Björn — the sea doesn't care how strong your arms are!

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: That crest is wrong — that's not water — BRACE!

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: Well. We're not dead. I had good money on dead.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Keep it.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: Two whole words. He's shaken. — Helgi, write it down.

lines.speaker: HELGI
lines.en: We're all shaken, Tove. Even the sword's gone quiet.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Hold on to something — all of you!

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: You can't cut it, Björn! Nobody can cut the sea!

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: That's two suns. I've sailed every sea there is. There is no sea under two suns.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Then where did our storm go? Where did the whole night go?

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Your orders, captain.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: ...Not mine to give anymore, kinsman. Yours.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: Down. On your knees, all of you. You fell out of the wrong sky.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: We mean you no harm —

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: Everyone says that. The river says otherwise.

lines.speaker: IPU
lines.en: ...Are they ghosts?

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: The water's coming wrong — LEFT of the black rock — NOW!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: I don't understand it. I'll trust it. MOVE!

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: ...How did she know? The tide never comes that way.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: The sky tore, and you fell out of it. That makes you mine.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: We belong to no one.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: Everyone here belongs to someone. You'll learn whose — or the water will teach you.

notes: SC02 is the designated natural-comedy beat (Tove gallows-humour vs Björn's one-word replies).
SC04 contains the leadership handoff Olaf→Björn (kinsman).
No canon event added/removed; these are the spoken realizations of the existing F11 beats.
translationReadiness: neutral international English; FR/ES derive from this master later, preserving meaning/tone/timing.
